name: Bolivia
overview:
Salt Bae-livia, amirite? Okay, we'll stop peppering in puns.

It feels right for Bolivia to be named after the man that decolonised the continent (Simon Bolivar for the uninitiated). Of all of the South Americans, Bolivia is closest to its indigenous roots.  

Bolivians are the poorest among South Americans, but in our opinion, they also have the purest hearts. You are met with a certain kindness in Bolivia that transcends the travel experience.

seo.description: Explore Bolivia with a five-day itinerary, seasonal guidance for the Uyuni salt flats, and practical inter-city travel notes.
